coding.note: Claims are limited to the abstract and introduction. GQA and SWA are presented as key model features, not as newly invented techniques. The SWA speed comparison does not establish a matched training ablation. Data disclosure is PARTIAL based only on instruction-tuning data categories; pretraining sources and mixture are undisclosed. MT-Bench iterations and standard deviations concern evaluation, not independent training runs. Comparator coding refers to the main results table (Table 2), whose models were re-evaluated.

models were re-evaluated on all metrics with our evaluation pipeline for accurate comparison.

claims.quote:
We introduce Mistral 7B, a 7–billion-parameter language model engineered for
  superior performance and efficiency.
claims.claim: Introduce Mistral 7B, a high-performance, efficient 7B model outperforming larger released models.

claims.quote:
GQA significantly accelerates the inference speed, and also reduces the memory requirement during
 decoding
claims.claim: Use grouped-query attention to accelerate inference and reduce decoding memory requirements.

claims.quote:
In addition, SWA is designed to handle longer sequences more effectively at a reduced
computational cost, thereby alleviating a common limitation in LLMs.
claims.claim: Use sliding-window attention to handle longer sequences at reduced computational cost.

claims.quote:
We also provide a model fine-tuned to follow instructions,
  Mistral 7B – Instruct, that surpasses Llama 2 13B – chat model both on human and
  automated benchmarks.
claims.claim: Provide Mistral 7B Instruct, outperforming Llama 2 13B Chat on human and automated benchmarks.

claims.quote:
This release is accompanied by a reference
implementation1 facilitating easy deployment either locally or on cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP,
or Azure
claims.claim: Provide a reference implementation enabling local and cloud deployment.
